about: The graduale of the formulary “Septuagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Thou art a helper in due season, in tribulation; let those who know Thy name trust in Thee, for Thou forsakest not those who seek Thee, O Lord. For the poor man shall not be forgotten for ever, nor shall the patience of the poor perish eternally; arise, O Lord, let not man prevail.
